rule: Distinguish formal-synthesis establishment from empirical validation, a new cross-paradigm law, a new morphology, and recursive improvement.

synthesis_theory.question: Are the definitions and axioms internally coherent and non-circular at the declared synthesis scope?
bugs_closed: history-only state omitted hidden machine configuration
legal development could smuggle human engineering
scalar verifier threshold did not cover heterogeneous evidence regimes
hidden world state could become free machine information
unregistered intervention class made minimality ambiguous
architecture identity omitted starting capital/development protocol
generality was incorrectly described as a partial order on machine identities rather than a preorder
finite-epsilon closeness was incorrectly tempting as an equivalence quotient
semantic state and realization/resource cost were conflated
publication_hardening_remaining: specialist measure-theory/control review for stochastic continuous formulations

synthesis_theory.question: Do major parent theories embed as explicit theorem modules/special cases without changing GMI definitions?
synthesis_theory.boundary: GMI imports parent results only under their native assumptions. It does not claim that all parent theorem assumptions hold simultaneously or that one parent theorem proves the whole synthesis.
publication_hardening_remaining: line-by-line primary-source theorem citations for every load-bearing imported statement
specialist review of parent-pair assumption compatibility where composed

synthesis_theory.question: Do materially different machine-intelligence forms instantiate the same morphology/state/resource schema without changing field meanings?
synthesis_theory.boundary: This is a formal schema embedding, not a proof that the families are computationally/resource equivalent or that one compiler preserves all developmental costs.

synthesis_theory.question: Are core frontier/dominance/scalarization/amortization/rank-shift semantics executable and exact on reference cases?
bugs_closed: strict dominance incorrectly survived a loss on another ecology
rank-information median fixture expected the wrong exact value
synthesis_theory.boundary: Reference checks establish definition semantics only; they do not establish real intelligence capability.

empirical_validation.question: Can pre-outcome structure predict later developmental burden within a nontrivial family on held-out tasks?
Does one compact predictor/invariant transfer across materially different morphology families beyond their native parent predictors?
Do the same GMI/HST definitions and developmental-capital criteria work in real formal mathematics, code/tools, language and science without semantic changes?
Can one persistent machine maintain and improve its developmental frontier over a heterogeneous lifetime?
Can a prospectively derived morphology/frontier phase transition be recovered endogenously from a neutral candidate space?

new_morphology.question: Can a theory-predicted parent-frontier hole be filled by a non-parent-equivalent morphology?
new_morphology.unlock: prospective obstruction/headroom region against strongest known/hybrid parents

recursive_improvement.question: Does the burden to discover verified frontier improvements decline across genuine fresh generations under a fixed constitution?

important_boundary: Failure of E1/E2/E5 would not erase the formal synthesis; it would show that the synthesis is a useful metrology/integration theory without a new predictive cross-paradigm law. Failure of E3/E4 would show that the theory does not yet explain broad real developmental intelligence.
